```{r Setup}
# load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(matchingR)

# set base folder
here::i_am("allocation_ma.Rmd")

# Import utils
purrr::walk(
  list.files(here::here("utils"), pattern = "\\.R$", full.names = TRUE),
  source
)

# Config
## Input Paths
supervisor_preferences_ma_path <- "input/supervisor_preferences_ma.txt"
student_preferences_ma_path <- "input/student_preferences_ma.txt"

## Output Paths
allocations_ma_path <- "output/allocations_ma.csv"
unassigned_ma_path <- "output/unassigned_ma.csv"
```


# Safely load data
```{r}
# Supervisor preferences
supervisor_preferences_ma <- load_supervisor_preferences(
  file_path = here(supervisor_preferences_ma_path),
  implicit_capacity_1 = FALSE
)

print(supervisor_preferences_ma)
```

```{r}
# Student preferences
student_preferences_ma <- load_student_preferences(
  file_path = here(student_preferences_ma_path)
)

print(student_preferences_ma)
```

# Check Data Validity
```{r}
# Cross validate Student and Supervisor Preferences
crossvalidate_preferences(student_preferences_ma, supervisor_preferences_ma)
```


# Allocate Students by Supervisor-Proposing Deferred Acceptance

```{r}
allocation_output_ma <- allocate_by_da(
  student_prefs = student_preferences_ma, 
  supervisor_prefs = supervisor_preferences_ma,
  debug = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
#matches
allocations_ma <- allocation_output_ma$matches
print(allocations_ma)
```

```{r}
# unassigned students/topics
unassigned_ma <- allocation_output_ma$unassigned
print(unassigned_ma)
```

# Write output

```{r}
write_csv(allocations_ma, here(allocations_ma_path))
write_csv(unassigned_ma, here(unassigned_ma_path))
```
